questions.topic: Signs of the ratios by quadrant
questions.learningObjective: Determine the sign of tangent in quadrant IV
questions.stem: On the board, an angle lies in quadrant IV. What is the sign of tan θ there?

options.misconception: assumes tangent is positive in all quadrants
confuses quadrant IV with an axis
tangent is undefined only at odd multiples of π/2

questions.explanation: Tan = sin/cos — yields "Negative". The key is B, "Negative". Option A ("Positive") is wrong: assumes tangent is positive in all quadrants. Option C ("Zero") is wrong: confuses quadrant IV with an axis. Option D ("Undefined") is wrong: tangent is undefined only at odd multiples of π/2.

questions.subject: INTEGRATED_1
questions.topic: General solutions of a trigonometric equation
questions.learningObjective: Solve sin x = 1 generally
questions.stem: A planner writes sin x = 1 on the board. What is the general solution?

options.misconception: gives the value 0, not 1
includes points where sine is -1
gives zeros of sine, not ones

questions.explanation: Sine peaks every 2π — yields "x = π/2 + 2πn". The key is D, "x = π/2 + 2πn". Option A ("x = π + 2πn") is wrong: gives the value 0, not 1. Option B ("x = π/2 + πn") is wrong: includes points where sine is -1. Option C ("x = 2πn") is wrong: gives zeros of sine, not ones.
